t: Wheat – Highland Specialty Grains
s: HSG Timberline has excellent cold tolerance for a spring wheat. It was among the few varieties which survived the harsh winter of 2023-24 in fall-planted DNS test plots in the Columbia Basin. Along with better cold tolerance, yield and protein are also an improvement over other spring varieties being planted in the fall in the Columbia Basin region. It also does well when planted in the spring. Seed is now available so give HSG Timberline a try! Highland Specialty Grains also has several other Hard Red Spring varieties available for licensing.
